entries.note: Packs' customer-service FAQ quotes it as the Track & Trace status of a parcel that is announced but not yet scanned at the sorting centre.
The tracker's status for a shipment the sender announced; the page explains that it is not yet collected or sorted.

entries.wording: Uw zending is aangemeld maar nog niet bij ons aangeboden.
entries.note: The announcement's wording in archived tracker pages: announced, not yet handed to Packs.

entries.wording: Uw zending is gereed voor verzending naar ons landelijk sorteercentrum.
entries.note: Seen in an archived tracker page in the afternoon after the announcement, with the next day's delivery window: ready at a regional Packscenter for the national sorting centre.

entries.wording: Uw zending is aangekomen in het regionale Packscenter.
entries.note: A regional Packscenter's scan, at either end of the journey: right after the announcement, or on the morning of the delivery.

entries.wording: Uw zending is bij ons sorteercentrum aangekomen.
Uw zending is in het sorteerproces.
entries.note: Seen in archived tracker pages, where the rail lights its sorting step.

entries.wording: De zending heeft een tijdvak toegekend gekregen.
entries.note: A delivery window was given. A planning notice; it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Er is een nieuw tijdvenster aan deze zending toegekend.
entries.note: A new delivery window was given. A planning notice; it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Er is een afleverinstructie aan de zending toegevoegd.
entries.note: A delivery instruction was added, as the delivery options page lets the recipient do. It moves nothing.
Seen in an archived tracker page; the expected delivery moved to the next working day.
